quote.text: Only consider at what price you sell your own will: if for no other reason, at least for this, that you sell it not for a small sum.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Consider that your personal will and values are the foundation for your child's growth; never bargain them away for fleeting conformity, as your steadfast character sets the tone for their own inner strength.
    • In moments of parental challenge, choose integrity over compromise—teaching by example that the price for yielding one's principles is too high to pay.
  • Leadership
    • True leadership demands that you hold fast to your convictions even in times of uncertainty; never surrender your will or core principles for immediate gain, for such acts can undermine the trust placed in you.
    • By refusing to undervalue your own judgment and moral compass, you inspire those around you to similarly guard their own integrity, fostering a culture of resilience and respect.
  • Product Management
    • Approach your work with the understanding that the vision and essence of your product must not be compromised for short-term metrics; a principled approach ensures lasting value over rapid, shallow success.
    • Just as Epictetus advises on the importance of preserving one’s will, maintain a clear sense of purpose in decision-making, ensuring that every pivot or feature aligns with the core vision and values of your product.
